title.en: Repairs, Rehabilitation and Retrofitting of Concrete Structure
title.gu: Concrete Structure નું Repair, Rehabilitation અને Retrofitting

title.en: Unit 6 Notes — Repairs, Rehabilitation and Retrofitting of Concrete Structure
title.gu: યુનિટ 6 Notes — Concrete Structure નું Repair, Rehabilitation અને Retrofitting

body.en:
Repair corrects local defects or damage, for example patching a spalled cover. Rehabilitation restores a structure to a satisfactory level of service by a coordinated set of measures. Retrofitting modifies an existing structure to improve capacity, ductility, service performance or resistance to a changed hazard, such as seismic action. The categories can overlap, but patching alone does not necessarily strengthen a deficient member.

Before intervention establish safe access, temporary support, use and loading restrictions, survey and structural assessment by a qualified engineer. Identify root cause and exposure; treating a symptom without correcting water ingress or corrosion allows recurrence.
body.gu:
Repair સ્થાનિક defect અથવા damage સુધારે છે, જેમ કે spalled cover નું patching. Rehabilitation સંકલિત પગલાંથી structure ને સંતોષકારક service સુધી પાછું લાવે છે. Retrofitting હાલના structure ની capacity, ductility, service performance અથવા બદલાયેલા hazard જેમ કે earthquake સામેની resistance સુધારે છે. આ શબ્દોમાં overlap છે, પરંતુ માત્ર patching થી નબળો member જરૂરી નથી કે મજબૂત બને.

કામ પહેલાં qualified engineer દ્વારા safe access, temporary support, ઉપયોગ અને loading restrictions, survey તથા structural assessment નક્કી કરો. મૂળ કારણ અને exposure શોધો; water ingress કે corrosion સુધાર્યા વગર માત્ર લક્ષણ દૂર કરવાથી નુકસાન ફરી થાય છે.

body.en:
Concrete may deteriorate by physical processes (abrasion, thermal movement, freeze–thaw where relevant), chemical attack (sulphates, acids, alkali–silica reaction), and structural or construction causes (overload, poor compaction, inadequate cover, cracking and leakage). Visible signs include cracks, delamination, spalling, staining and excessive deflection; the same symptom can have different causes.

Prevention includes exposure-appropriate materials and cover, low permeability, good compaction and curing, drainage, joint detailing, controlled loading and maintenance. Map damage, document crack width and movement, assess exposure, and test as required before selecting a repair. Do not seal an actively moving crack with a rigid resin without addressing movement.
body.gu:
Concrete deterioration ના કારણો physical (abrasion, thermal movement, જ્યાં લાગુ ત્યાં freeze–thaw), chemical (sulphates, acids, alkali–silica reaction) અને structural અથવા construction સંબંધિત (overload, અપૂરતું compaction/cover, cracks અને leakage) હોઈ શકે છે. ચિહ્નોમાં cracks, delamination, spalling, staining અને વધુ deflection આવે છે; એકસરખું લક્ષણ જુદા કારણોથી હોઈ શકે છે.

નિવારણમાં exposure મુજબ materials અને cover, ઓછી permeability, સારું compaction તથા curing, drainage, joints, controlled loading અને maintenance આવે છે. Repair પસંદ કરતા પહેલાં damage map કરો, crack width અને movement નોંધો, exposure તપાસો અને જરૂરી tests કરો. હલતી crack ને movement નો વિચાર કર્યા વગર rigid resin થી બંધ ન કરો.

body.en:
Alkaline concrete normally protects steel through a passive film. Carbonation reduces alkalinity and chlorides can break down passivity; with moisture and oxygen corrosion can proceed. Corrosion products occupy more volume than the original steel, causing cracking, delamination and spalling. Section loss reduces steel area and bond. Stains are clues, not a complete measurement of remaining capacity.

Prevention and control include adequate dense cover and curing, limiting chloride ingress, waterproofing and drainage, suitable corrosion-resistant reinforcement or protective systems, and in selected projects engineered cathodic protection. Remove contaminated or unsound concrete, assess and treat steel and restore cover to the approved design; a cosmetic patch over active corrosion is inadequate.
body.gu:
Alkaline concrete સામાન્ય રીતે passive film વડે steel ને રક્ષણ આપે છે. Carbonation alkalinity ઘટાડે છે અને chlorides passivity તોડી શકે છે; moisture તથા oxygen હોય ત્યારે corrosion આગળ વધી શકે છે. Corrosion products મૂળ steel કરતાં વધુ volume લેતાં cracking, delamination અને spalling થાય છે. Section loss steel area અને bond ઘટાડે છે. Stains એ સંકેત છે, બાકી capacity નું સંપૂર્ણ માપ નહીં.

નિવારણમાં પૂરતું dense cover અને curing, chloride ingress નિયંત્રણ, waterproofing તથા drainage, યોગ્ય corrosion-resistant reinforcement અથવા protective systems અને પસંદ કરેલા projects માં engineered cathodic protection આવે છે. Contaminated/unsound concrete દૂર કરી steel તપાસો અને treat કરો તથા approved design મુજબ cover પુનઃસ્થાપિત કરો; ચાલુ corrosion ઉપર ફક્ત cosmetic patch પૂરતું નથી.

body.en:
1. Assess and make safe: survey, diagnose cause, establish repair boundaries, verify structural capacity and install temporary supports if required. 2. Remove: carefully break out unsound concrete to sound material without unnecessarily damaging retained reinforcement; preserve structural stability. 3. Prepare: clean substrate and corroded steel, assess bar section and replace/supplement steel only to an engineer’s design; prepare the surface profile and moisture condition specified by the repair system.

4. Apply: place the compatible bonding treatment and approved repair material using the specified method, thickness and working time; fill fully and avoid trapped voids. 5. Cure and inspect: cure according to the material, restore protection and drainage, check bond and defects, document work and monitor. Bonding products and curing methods are not interchangeable across all repair systems.
body.gu:
1. Assessment અને safety: Survey કરી કારણ શોધો, repair boundaries નક્કી કરો, structural capacity ચકાસો અને જરૂર હોય temporary supports લગાવો. 2. Removal: જાળવવાના reinforcement ને અનાવશ્યક નુકસાન વગર unsound concrete sound material સુધી કાળજીથી દૂર કરો; structural stability જાળવો. 3. Preparation: Substrate અને corroded steel સાફ કરો, bar section તપાસો અને engineer ના design મુજબ જ steel બદલો કે વધારો; repair system મુજબ surface profile અને moisture condition તૈયાર કરો.

4. Application: Compatible bonding treatment અને approved repair material નિર્ધારિત method, thickness તથા working time પ્રમાણે લગાવો; પૂરેપૂરો ભરો અને voids ટાળો. 5. Curing અને inspection: Material પ્રમાણે curing કરો, protection તથા drainage પુનઃસ્થાપિત કરો, bond અને defects તપાસો, કામ નોંધો અને monitoring કરો. બધા repair systems માં bonding products અને curing methods એકબીજાના બદલે વાપરી શકાય નહીં.

items.syllabus_item: 6.5 cement steel shotcrete epoxy resins/mortar gypsum and quick setting mortars

body.en:
Repair choices include cement mortar or concrete, polymer-modified or non-shrink repair mortars, steel reinforcement, shotcrete, epoxy resin, epoxy mortar, gypsum cement mortar and quick-setting cement mortar. Shotcrete is pneumatically projected mortar or concrete; wet- and dry-mix processes differ. Epoxy resin bonds suitable clean, sound surfaces and can inject certain dormant cracks; epoxy mortar adds aggregate/filler. Quick-setting mortar can help stop active water leaks if suited to the condition; rapid set alone does not establish structural performance. Gypsum-containing products are moisture-sensitive in many applications and should only be selected where the specification and exposure allow.

Check strength, stiffness, shrinkage, thermal compatibility, bond, permeability, corrosion risk, substrate moisture, temperature, curing and intended use. Consult product technical data and project specification; respect chemical safety, ventilation and protective equipment.
body.gu:
Repair માટે cement mortar/concrete, polymer-modified અથવા non-shrink repair mortars, steel reinforcement, shotcrete, epoxy resin, epoxy mortar, gypsum cement mortar અને quick-setting cement mortar વપરાય છે. Shotcrete એ pneumatic રીતે projected mortar અથવા concrete છે; wet-mix અને dry-mix processes જુદી છે. Epoxy resin યોગ્ય સ્વચ્છ sound surfaces ને bond કરી શકે અને કેટલીક dormant cracks માં inject થાય છે; epoxy mortar માં aggregate/filler હોય છે. યોગ્ય quick-setting mortar ચાલુ water leak રોકવામાં ઉપયોગી હોઈ શકે; ઝડપી set થવું structural performance નો પુરાવો નથી. Gypsum ધરાવતા products ઘણા ઉપયોગોમાં moisture-sensitive છે; specification અને exposure મંજૂર કરે ત્યારે જ પસંદ કરો.

Strength, stiffness, shrinkage, thermal compatibility, bond, permeability, corrosion risk, substrate moisture, temperature, curing અને ઉપયોગ તપાસો. Product technical data તથા project specification અનુસરો; chemical safety, ventilation અને protective equipment રાખો.

h.en: 6.6 Repair techniques for cracks and voids
h.gu: 6.6 Cracks અને voids માટે repair techniques

items.syllabus_item: 6.6 grouting, guniting, routing and sealing, stitching, drilling and plugging

body.en:
Grouting injects a suitable flowable material into voids or joints; choose cementitious or chemical grout for width, moisture and purpose. Guniting is dry-mix shotcrete application with water added at the nozzle; control rebound, application and curing. Routing and sealing opens the surface crack to a suitable groove and fills it with a compatible sealant, often for watertightness or movement accommodation. Stitching uses appropriately anchored steel connectors across a crack to help transfer tension; design anchorage and corrosion protection.

Drilling and plugging provides a formed key or plug through a suitable crack configuration to limit leakage or displacement; applicability is case-specific and it is not a general substitute for structural repair. Epoxy injection may restore continuity in suitable dormant structural cracks where the material and substrate conditions permit; active, wet, contaminated or moving cracks need a different assessed solution. Grouting and injection must not increase damage by uncontrolled pressure.
body.gu:
Grouting માં યોગ્ય flowable material voids કે joints માં inject થાય છે; width, moisture અને હેતુ મુજબ cementitious અથવા chemical grout પસંદ કરો. Guniting dry-mix shotcrete છે જેમાં nozzle પર water ઉમેરાય છે; rebound, application અને curing નિયંત્રિત કરો. Routing and sealing માં surface crack ને યોગ્ય groove બનાવી compatible sealant ભરાય છે, સામાન્ય રીતે watertightness અથવા movement માટે. Stitching માં crack પાર યોગ્ય anchorage ધરાવતા steel connectors થી tension transfer માં મદદ થાય છે; anchorage અને corrosion protection design કરો.

Drilling and plugging માં યોગ્ય crack configuration માં formed key અથવા plug બનાવી leakage કે displacement મર્યાદિત કરાય છે; તેની suitability case-specific છે અને તે સામાન્ય structural repair નો વિકલ્પ નથી. Epoxy injection યોગ્ય dormant structural cracks માં, material અને substrate conditions અનુરૂપ હોય તો, continuity પુનઃસ્થાપિત કરી શકે; active, wet, contaminated અથવા moving cracks માટે અલગ assessed solution જોઈએ. અનિયંત્રિત injection pressure થી વધુ damage ન થવું જોઈએ.

items.syllabus_item: 6.7 bracing, jacketing, plate bonding, isolation, mass reduction, walls, FRP, injection, section enlargement

body.en:
Methods: steel bracing or added shear walls can change lateral stiffness and seismic load paths; reinforced-concrete or steel jacketing and section enlargement can increase member capacity when connections transfer force. External bonded steel plates or fibre reinforced polymer (FRP) can strengthen selected members; bond, anchorage, fire protection and environmental exposure govern performance. Base isolation changes how earthquake motion reaches the superstructure; mass reduction can reduce seismic inertia demand. Wall thickening can improve a wall only when its foundations, connections and overall behaviour are checked. Epoxy injection may repair suitable dormant cracks but is not automatically a complete seismic retrofit.

All methods need a qualified structural engineer to assess the existing condition, load path, foundations, global stiffness and failure modes, and to design detailing, anchorage and construction sequence. Temporary support, fire safety, access and inspection are part of the scheme. No generic jacket thickness or FRP layout is safe without project-specific design.
body.gu:
Methods: Steel bracing અથવા નવા shear walls lateral stiffness અને seismic load path બદલી શકે છે; reinforced-concrete/steel jacketing અને section enlargement યોગ્ય force-transfer connections સાથે member capacity વધારી શકે છે. External bonded steel plates અથવા fibre reinforced polymer (FRP) પસંદ કરેલા members મજબૂત કરી શકે; bond, anchorage, fire protection અને environmental exposure મહત્વપૂર્ણ છે. Base isolation earthquake motion superstructure સુધી પહોંચવાની રીત બદલે છે; mass reduction seismic inertia demand ઘટાડી શકે. Wall thickening માટે foundations, connections અને સમગ્ર વર્તન તપાસવું જરૂરી છે. Epoxy injection યોગ્ય dormant cracks repair કરી શકે, પરંતુ તે આપોઆપ સંપૂર્ણ seismic retrofit નથી.

બધી methods માટે qualified structural engineer હાલની condition, load path, foundations, global stiffness અને failure modes તપાસી detailing, anchorage અને construction sequence design કરે. Temporary support, fire safety, access અને inspection પણ યોજના નો ભાગ છે. Project-specific design વગર કોઈ સામાન્ય jacket thickness કે FRP layout સલામત ગણવો નહીં.

body.en:
Given: A rectangular patch is 0.60 m long, 0.40 m wide and 0.05 m deep. Find its geometric volume, excluding waste.

Step 1. Write the volume expression.

V = length × width × depth

Step 2. Substitute the dimensions.

V = 0.60 × 0.40 × 0.05

Final answer:

Patch volume = 0.012 m³ = 12 L
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Rectangular patch 0.60 m લાંબો, 0.40 m પહોળો અને 0.05 m ઊંડો છે. Waste સિવાય geometric volume ગણો.

Step 1. Volume નું સૂત્ર લખો.

V = length × width × depth

Step 2. Dimensions ની કિંમત મૂકો.

V = 0.60 × 0.40 × 0.05

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Patch volume = 0.012 m³ = 12 L

body.en:
Given: A repair volume is 0.012 m³. Allow 10% extra for waste. Find the planned mortar volume.

Step 1. Find the waste allowance.

Waste = 0.012 × 0.10Waste = 0.0012 m³

Step 2. Add the allowance.

Planned volume = 0.012 + 0.0012

Final answer:

Planned volume = 0.0132 m³
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Repair volume 0.012 m³ છે. Waste માટે 10% વધુ લો. Planned mortar volume ગણો.

Step 1. Waste allowance ગણો.

Waste = 0.012 × 0.10Waste = 0.0012 m³

Step 2. Allowance ઉમેરો.

Planned volume = 0.012 + 0.0012

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Planned volume = 0.0132 m³

body.en:
Given: For a simplified uniform circular bar, diameter is reduced by corrosion from 20 mm to 18 mm. Estimate percentage loss of cross-sectional area. Actual corroded bars may be non-uniform and need engineering assessment.

Step 1. Write area in terms of diameter.

A = πd² / 4

Step 2. Calculate remaining area ratio.

Aremaining / Aoriginal = 18² / 20²Aremaining / Aoriginal = 0.81

Step 3. Calculate the loss.

Area loss (%) = (1 − 0.81) × 100

Final answer:

Idealised area loss = 19%; do not infer member capacity from this alone.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: સરળીકૃત સમાન circular bar નો diameter corrosion થી 20 mm થી 18 mm થયો છે. Cross-sectional area નું percentage loss ગણો. વાસ્તવિક corrosion અસમાન હોઈ શકે છે અને engineering assessment જરૂરી છે.

Step 1. Diameter પરથી area નું સૂત્ર લખો.

A = πd² / 4

Step 2. બાકી area નો ratio ગણો.

Aremaining / Aoriginal = 18² / 20²Aremaining / Aoriginal = 0.81

Step 3. ઘટાડો ગણો.

Area loss (%) = (1 − 0.81) × 100

અંતિમ જવાબ:

આદર્શ area loss = 19%; આ પરથી એકલા member capacity ન નક્કી કરો.
